**Unitary authority with the largest drop in per‑meter‑point domestic gas consumption (2012 → 2023)**  

| Authority | 2012 consumption (kWh / meter‑point) | 2023 consumption (kWh / meter‑point) | Drop (kWh / meter‑point) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flintshire | 12,571.0 | 9,289.3 | **3,281.7** |
| County Durham | 13,681.0 | 10,636.2 | 3,044.8 |
| Bedford | 12,713.0 | 9,960.1 | 2,752.9 |
| North Lincolnshire | 13,031.0 | 10,054.2 | 2,976.8 |
| Telford & Wrekin | 11,879.0 | 9,101.0 | 2,778.0 |

**Answer:** Flintshire had the biggest drop, losing **about 3,282 kWh per meter‑point** from 2012 to 2023.

*Sources*

- Office for National Statistics (ONS) “Domestic gas consumption” indicator – values for each authority in 2012 and 2023 (per‑meter‑point). (Retrieved from the ONS exploration page for domestic gas consumption).
